appearances.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES

recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: It was -- you know, he said that a mighty tree at some point has to fall so that the young trees can grow up and take over. And as much tribute has been paid to Ma Dukes, I want to say that we are in good hands with L. Joy Williams. I was there when Ma Dukes anointed her the leader of Brooklyn. And now she has -- she is that new young tree that is taking the place of Ma Dukes. Thank you, Mr.…

recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. I will -- you know, I sit next to Senator Sanders. I listen to him all the time. It usually goes in one ear and out the other. But today I was moved. You know, Sanders, you actually said something good.

recent.text: -- of millionaires? Because there are lots of millionaires moving to New York also.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Okay. But would you -- so it's a net migration --

recent.text: Just a real quick response to one of your statements. You said we have a net outmigration --

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Well, thank you. hopefully we get this off the ground.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: And do they get tax {unintelligible} just for New York State income tax or federal income taxes?

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: So the employees in this -- participating in the Secure Choice program, would they also get the tax benefits such as --

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: And will the state -- meaning your department -- keep track of the accounts, the contributions from the employees?

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: I see, all right. I wanted you to talk about this new program that I don't know why I haven't heard of before, Secure Choice. So is that something that's going to be rolled out in Tax Year 2025?

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: I see. Got it. So that's your preference, then.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Oh, so you don't want to be.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Okay. I'm not sure why the delay. You clearly are qualified for this. So hopefully the Governor will --

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. And thank you, Commissioner, for coming today. How long have you been acting commissioner? You should be real commissioner.
